title: 30-Minute Full-Body Aesthetic Strength 2X  - V1.0
author: Jack
desc:
This is a condensed and focused 8-week strength and hypertrophy program built around two 30-minute full-body workouts per week. The program emphasizes shoulders, back, arms, and glutes while maintaining balanced strength, core work, grip, and general athleticism.  

Each workout combines a small number of compound lifts with targeted accessory work. Optional 10–15 minute accessory blocks can be added when time and energy allow. The main workout is complete without them. For the optional accessory work, you can do drop sets or other finishing sets that you prefer. ￼

I created this program out of a need for an efficient aesthetic and strength based program with some durability work that I could do when low on time or getting back into a gym schedule. I pulled inspiration from other programs I’ve enjoyed over the years.

This program can also be helpful add-on to other short programs, such as bodyweight workouts at home before getting to the gym or before your cardio exercise for the day. ￼
